verified_by_elf_selftest: RawExperience has no authoritative trust, anchor_alignment, cross_context_count or independently_verified fields.
Valid verifier envelope derives trust eligibility and anchor alignment from pinned evidence/policy.
A verifier envelope copied onto a new event fails closed.
Rewrapping the same underlying evidence under a new event ID retains the same evidence-derived lineage root.
Cross-context count is ledger-derived from accepted appraisals rather than producer supplied.
Replay of the same appraisal does not inflate evidence/context/lineage counts.
Same underlying lineage across different contexts does not inflate independent-lineage count.
Duplicate attestations from the same verifier generation do not inflate verifier count.
10,000 distinct forged event IDs reusing one valid verifier envelope produce zero accepted appraisals and zero cross-context/lineage support.
Changing underlying evidence changes the evidence-set hash.
known_remaining_gaps: Verifier identity Sybil/collusion resistance still requires an external verifier registry/independence policy; verifier_id strings alone are not sufficient identity proof.
semantic_subject_hash/source_artifact_hash are evidence inputs and require a trusted acquisition/derivation contract to resist lineage spoofing.

Raw feature extraction still needs a versioned evidence-bound FeatureExtractor contract; producer-injected feature names are ignored unless the pinned anchor mapping consumes them, but trusted feature provenance remains future work.
Anchor feature weights are research placeholders and remain TEST_REQUIRED; shadow value-anchor seed is not live personality.
No formal B implementation or independent C verification exists.
